name: AgVice
story: AgVice used GIS, digital farm plans, drones and web mapping in farm-environment and catchment work. Eagle’s Wai Kōkopu material documents ArcGIS, StoryMaps and Experience Builder in the programme, while AgVice’s own material identifies Debbie Care as founder.
